name: Batliboi Ltd
title: Batliboi Ltd-$ - 522004 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Batliboi FY26 revenue up 7% to INR440 cr with PAT about INR7 cr; order inflow INR990 cr and backlog INR593 cr, but no numeric FY27 guidance and backlog-vs-revenue gap is unexplained.

capex.quote: We have incurred a cumulative capex of INR27 crores in FY’26 and plan to close FY’27 with an additional capex of around INR10 crores.

triggers.label: Order inflow INR990 cr in FY26
triggers.quote: we recorded an order inflow of almost INR990 crores in FY’26
triggers.highlight: order inflow of almost INR990 crores

triggers.label: Canada expansion CAD 4 mn pending permits
triggers.quote: In Canada, it will be something in the region of about CAD 4 million

triggers.label: Backlog gap vs revenue unexplained
triggers.quote: the order backlog reflects both the direct busine ss and the indirect business

guidance.quote: I am further confident of an improved result both in top-line and bottom-line in FY’27.
plan to close FY’27 with an additional capex of around INR10 crores
our debt -to-equity ratio now comfortably at 0.28x, a level we intend to sustain going forward

red_flags.label: Order backlog does not reconcile with reported revenue
red_flags.quote: The mismatch is because our revenue reported does not take the indirect sales into our books.

red_flags.label: Operating margin ~7%, no improvement for years
red_flags.quote: like for last since four-five years, we haven't seen any improvement on this

red_flags.label: Debtors up, Bangladesh exposure queried
red_flags.quote: all our business, export business, is covered under letters of credit, 100%

evasions.quote: we don't give information on division-wise profitability
all I can say is that the performance will be better than what we have achieved this year
Which is a peer? I mean, sorry, which companies do you compare us to?
